rootText: Home Lifestage Retirement Retirement No matter where you are in life, it’s never too early to prepare for retirement. Your golden years are the time for freedom, security, and fulfilment – start planning for a more secure tomorrow. Contact us Live fully in your golden years Focus on living your golden years and prioritise what matters the most to you. Medium priority Protection In the event of unexpected circumstances such as critical illnesses, accidents or death, your nest egg might be impacted by rising healthcare costs. Your priority for protection: Adequate cover from age-related health issues and medical treatments that will last until demise.Additional cover for long-term care. Plan your protection Medium priority Wealth To pursue passions, travel the world, and spend quality time with loved ones without financial worry, you’ll need sufficient finances. Your priority for wealth: Retirement savings and income.Legacy planning including a will and CPF nomination. Build your wealth Learn more about your needs Protection Wealth Protection Health needs may increase as you age – the sooner you get insured, the more peace of mind you’ll have. What you already have¹ If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes: MediSave A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement. MediShield Life A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs. CareShield Life Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability. What you may consider² You might have insurance protection policies, but are you truly covered for health issues and increased risk of accidents that come with age? The key is ensuring you have enough coverage to avoid dipping into your retirement savings. You’ll need: Critical Illness Plan Integrated Shield Plan Personal Accident Plan You might also need to review your insurance plans to see if they remain affordable when you’re no longer drawing a salary. Why act now Health issues may increase as you age². Healthcare and medical treatments should not deplete your retirement savings². Connect with a Financial Representative for personalised coverage. Misconceptions? Let’s correct them. Check out some common misunderstandings about financial planning and their truths. It is okay not to disclose your existing medical condition. Learn more I am not eligible for insurance because I am too old or have a pre-existing condition. Learn more Having health insurance means all treatments are fully covered. Learn more Close Close Close Find the right plan Critical illness Medical & accident Prepare for your health gap years—the period when a critical illness diagnosis may require time away from work to focus on recovery for yourself or your loved ones. Be protected from the financial impact of serious conditions such as cancer, stroke, and heart attack, so you can recover with peace of mind and continue supporting your family in the event of a critical illness. PRUActive Protect A customisable critical illness insurance plan that can be built as you grow, providing coverage against recurring early stage critical illnesses and more. Learn more opens in a new tab Wealth Your golden years are the time to kick back and live the life you desire. In addition to securing your protection, planning for your goals, including legacy planning, is essential. Basics – what you should have A Plan For Monthly Payouts³ Choose from three CPF LIFE plans to fit your needs. Emergency Funds⁴,⁵ At least 3 – 6 months’ worth of expenses for rainy days. Legacy Planning⁴,⁵ A plan for a will, family trusts, life insurance, powers of attorney, and CPF nominations. Invest At Least 10% Of Take-Home Pay⁵ For retirement, if you are currently earning a steady income and not yet retired. What you may consider It pays to start planning for retirement early. To see if your nest egg is sufficient, consider the kind of lifestyle you want to lead, how long you expect to be in retirement, and what amount of income you desire. Here's how to find out if your savings will last⁶: Calculate Needs: Review your expenses before and during retirement. Assess Resources: Add your savings and any monthly payouts. Consider Inflation: Take into account inflation and your expected investment returns. Find The Gap: Subtract the needs from the resources. If the result is negative, you may find it challenging to maintain a comfortable retirement. More ways to bridge the gap⁴,⁵: Investment Or Savings Plans Tap Into Your Assets If you are 55 years old or above, explore monetising your property (Silver Housing Bonus, Lease Buyback Scheme, renting out room / flat). Spend Within Your Means Why act now More time to build good habits and grow your savings⁷. Age with purpose and dignity as lifespans get longer⁸. Maintain lifestyle amidst increased spending due to inflation⁹. Connect with a Financial Representative for personalised coverage. Misconceptions? Let’s correct them. Check out some common misunderstandings about financial planning and their truths. ILPs are a risky investment move. Learn more The older you get, the more you pay for ILP premiums.
